_about: Seed for WORK_DIR/manifest.json (Bill, 2026-09-27). The installed copy is the company's: it sets keep_days and backup per folder, and Alice carries them out. A folder the code names that the installed copy lacks is added from here. keep_days null = keep; backup none | local | offsite; token none | company | import. Readme: webclerk.com readmes — architecture/work-folders.

bundles.purpose: bundle payloads in and out: <model>/<incoming|outgoing>/<pending|processed|rejected>, the GL journal and select-list files

imports/digest.purpose: nightly record of each import: content hash, approvals, who imported

outbox.purpose: files made to send or hand to someone

logs.purpose: server, Celery, hook, sync and balance logs

cache.purpose: derived and rebuildable (chroma vectors); delete freely

state.purpose: small working state the server keeps (layout history, dismissals)

scripts.purpose: company tools, run by a person; the server never executes anything here

certs.purpose: certificates and keys; owner-only; never leaves the machine unencrypted
